chunks: And as for what was narrated: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Faddal from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: 'In the case of a man who marries a woman for temporary marriage (mut'ah), they inherit from each other if they do not stipulate [a specific term], and the stipulation is [made] after the marriage.'

Thus, the meaning of this report is that if they did not stipulate the term, they inherit from each other, without the meaning being the stipulation of inheritance itself. And that which indicates this is what was narrated:
ai.seo_question: Do spouses in temporary marriage (mut'ah) inherit from each other?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq to clarify that temporary marriage (mut'ah) spouses inherit from each other by default, provided they do not stipulate a specific duration (ajal). The text explicitly distinguishes between stipulating the time limit versus stipulating the right of inheritance itself, affirming that the absence of a time condition does not negate inheritance rights.
